howItWorks.title: Check availability
howItWorks.text: Get in touch through the enquiry form on his website to find out whether he is free on your date and to ask any questions.

howItWorks.title: Meet Harry
howItWorks.text: If you would like to meet him first, he offers a free coffee or Zoom call and will show you some magic.

howItWorks.title: Plan the timing
howItWorks.text: He works with you to find the best time and place for magic at your event. For weddings, he builds a plan with the couple around their day.

goodToKnow.text: He shapes each performance around the audience, the space and the style of the event.
At weddings, the drinks-reception set is designed to keep guests entertained while the photographs are being taken.

faqs.a: Anywhere you like. He is based between London and New York and is available worldwide.

He says the answer depends on the event. Magic can break the ice for a group of people who have not met before, or be a surprise addition to a dinner party, and either way it gives everyone a shared experience of wonder.

faqs.q: How large an audience can he perform for?
faqs.a: His parlour show is designed for small to medium groups in a living room or private dining room. His stage magic suits audiences of hundreds or thousands and can be scaled to fit any size of stage or theatre.

faqs.q: What is 'the turnover' at a wedding?
faqs.a: It is the gap between the wedding meal and the evening guests arriving. He suggests using it to keep the energy going into the evening and to welcome new arrivals with a surprise.

faqs.q: Will he tell us how the tricks work?
faqs.a: He follows the saying that magicians keep secrets for you, not from you. If you ask very nicely, he might explain one or two tricks, as long as you do not tell anyone.

serviceDetails.name: Close-up and roaming magic
serviceDetails.more: He pitches it as the chance to see the kind of tricks people are sceptical of on television, up close and in their own hands. The aim is to give guests something to laugh about, talk about and share together.

serviceDetails.name: Stage and after-dinner magic
serviceDetails.more: Some routines involve everyone in the room at once, creating a reaction on a scale he says you will not have seen before.

serviceDetails.name: Wedding magic
serviceDetails.more: Between courses at the wedding breakfast, his table-to-table sets are designed as an ice-breaker and talking point for each table. At the evening reception he mixes and mingles between groups to round off the day.

serviceDetails.name: Event hosting and compèring
serviceDetails.more: He describes his hosting as reliable, relaxed and captivating: he keeps the event moving, makes each transition feel effortless and brings the room together.

serviceDetails.name: Parlour show
serviceDetails.more: It is designed for friends, family or colleagues gathered in one room, and the audience is involved throughout.

serviceDetails.name: Bespoke brand magic
serviceDetails.more: Behind the scenes he has created, written and directed magic for internationally recognised performers, major West End productions and global brand campaigns. He brings that experience to original pieces designed for a specific event, audience or brand.

notes: All pages were fetched on 27 October 2026. His website publishes no prices, deposit or cancellation terms, notice period, set lengths, travel fees or technical and space requirements, so none are given. Consultancy credits are as he lists them and were not independently verified. The awards, audience and country counts, and celebrity and client quotes on his homepage are self-published and were not used here. The Reviews page loads its content dynamically, and none of it was readable in the fetched page, so no reviews were used. The contact form's fields were not visible in the fetched HTML and the form was not opened or submitted. The Showreel page contains only an embedded video.
